topography.project_purpose: Leveraged Farming. Structurally: 18 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 3 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (payments, proxy, erc1967upgrade). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
